note: Appended by scripts/status-probe.sh (run from .github/workflows/status-probe.yml). A sample is recorded when the observed state changes, and otherwise once every heartbeat_hours so that 'no new samples' cannot be confused with 'the prober is dead'. The record starts on record_started_at: it makes no claim about anything before that date.

targets.name: Delivery Service
targets.proves: The DS container is up and answering. It is a liveness probe only — it returns a static 'ok' without touching the database.

targets.name: Delivery Service build
targets.proves: Which git commit the running DS was built from. A changed sha is a deploy.

targets.name: Transparency log
targets.proves: The signed head of the MLS commit-log tree is being served. Its tree_size is recorded; its timestamp is not a liveness signal (see publisher).

targets.name: Downloads
targets.proves: The release manifest the download buttons and install scripts read is reachable.

targets.name: Website
targets.proves: pollis.com is served. It says nothing about whether the deployed pages match main — website-verify.yml checks that separately, and by content.
